name: @hdsp/canvas-engine
description: Framework-agnostic canvas engine core (scene graph, spatial index, event bus, command system, viewport, FormSchema bridge) for HDSP Healthcare Document Studio. MUST have zero React/DOM dependencies (ADR-004) — @hdsp/form-schema is a data-only dependency (types + zod + semver), not React/DOM, so it does not violate that constraint.
